capabilities: Rewrites dropped attachment syntax to link or embed by extension
Configures separate link and embed extension lists in settings
Keeps native storage, filenames and Wiki or Markdown link style
Protects existing links and ambiguous insertions from rewriting
Exposes events for cooperating importers such as Mail Drop
extras: No network requests or telemetry; settings are indexed by built-in search on Obsidian 1.13+; public events let importers reuse the rule engine.
problem: Obsidian applies one link or embed syntax to every dropped attachment, so PDFs and images cannot default differently without manual editing.

relations.evidence: With Mail Drop 0.10.0 or later, choose Use attachment rules in Mail Drop.

summary: Extension-based rule engine that turns dropped attachments into links or embeds, leaving native storage and filenames intact.
